brief: Two-storey dark-brick elementary school of 1914 by Perkins, Fellows & Hamilton of Chicago, a Prairie-influenced design: a low hipped central block with a canted bay of banded windows, flanked by tall brick stair towers with stone-trimmed entrances and end wings, tall chimneys rising behind. Broad groups of windows with stone sills and belt courses; a chain-link fenced playground in front and small houses on the surrounding streets.
